name: dev_ray47439_xgboost_deadlock
description: Source case: Ray issue #47439. A 4-CPU cluster; the XGBoost tuning trial reserves a 4-CPU parent placement group, then its nested distributed trainer requests a 3-CPU child placement group. The child cannot fit because the parent holds the entire cluster. The trial enters WAITING_CHILD indefinitely and forms a self-cycle in the wait-for graph.
